purpose: Test whether the predicted glyph-feature likelihood, used only as a ranking term, improves a 50 ms MLP classifier on Task 3. Experiment 73 showed the feature likelihood cannot generate candidates; this asks whether it can verify them.

data.eeg: public train only, data/derived repeat ordinals via experiment 70 loader
data.features: 40 handcrafted glyph features from experiment 70 (z-scored over the 2748-image public library)

base.model: src.neural.SpikeClassifier, 2748 classes, hidden 1024, dropout 0, apply_log False
base.training: AdamW lr 3e-4, weight decay 0, batch 256, gradient clip 5, seed 42, fixed 10 epochs, per-session z-scored 50 ms log1p counts
base.note: matches the 50 ms single view of experiment 69; no early stopping and no held-repeat information

feature_term.predictor: closed-form ridge from the same 50 ms inputs, alpha chosen on the inner repeat, targets = 40 z-scored glyph features
feature_term.likelihood: negative diagonal-Gaussian distance to each library feature vector, per-feature error variance from the inner repeat

arms.fused_full: z(logits) + lambda * z(likelihood), lambda = 0.25 fixed a priori
arms.fused_top32: same fused score, but candidates restricted to the base argmax top-32; only the order inside that set changes
arms.sensitivity: lambda in {0.1, 0.5, 1.0} reported descriptively, no OCF, never used for selection

metrics.top1: held argmax identity accuracy over all 10992 held rows per mouse-fold
metrics.ocf: official OCF on fold k=4 only, whole 2748-trial session block assigned by Hungarian before picture subsetting, RNG123 heldout pictures [256:768]
metrics.note: oracle@32 is not computed in this experiment; it is diagnostic only and not part of any rule

pass_rule.advance: top1 increases for both mice AND fold-4 OCF increases for both mice AND at least 5 of the 8 mouse x session groups have non-negative OCF change
pass_rule.reject: otherwise the feature likelihood is not a usable verifier for Task 3 and the route is closed

prohibited: selecting lambda on the held repeat or on the heldout pictures
changing the base model or epochs after seeing results
hidden test data, image-index priors, or sample-ID alignment
